clips.title: The story
paras: At Ivar Patch in northern Silverpine Forest, a ruined harvest hides the fate of its farmhands.

Before the Third War, Ivar's pumpkin farm was a prosperous homestead in Lordaeron. Ivar employed lively farmhands and servants, but the Scourge spread the Plague of Undeath across the countryside and consumed the farm. Ivar, his family, and his laborers rose again as rotting, feral ghouls, bound to prowl the ruined soil without their minds. Unlike the Forsaken, they have no free will.
